title: Save Energy!
statementMd:
Julia is going to cook a chicken in the kitchen of her dormitory. To save energy, the stove in the kitchen automatically turns off after $*k*$ minutes after turning on.

During cooking, Julia goes to the kitchen every $*d*$ minutes and turns on the stove if it is turned off. While the cooker is turned off, it stays warm. The stove switches on and off instantly.

It is known that the chicken needs $*t*$ minutes to be cooked on the stove, if it is turned on, and $2*t*$ minutes, if it is turned off. You need to find out, how much time will Julia have to cook the chicken, if it is considered that the chicken is cooked evenly, with constant speed when the stove is turned on and at a constant speed when it is turned off.

## Input

The single line contains three integers $*k*$, $*d*$ and $*t*$ ($1 ≤ *k*, *d*, *t* ≤ 10^{18}$).

## Output

Print a single number, the total time of cooking in minutes. The relative or absolute error must not exceed $10^{ - 9}$.

Namely, let's assume that your answer is $*x*$ and the answer of the jury is $*y*$. The checker program will consider your answer correct if ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2f8a2579030cb3dd486cf891669979cfd6c0cd65.png).

## Note

In the first example, the chicken will be cooked for 3 minutes on the turned on stove, after this it will be cooked for ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cce5d3f2f46552034d5ae5d487725705429ec7a5.png). Then the chicken will be cooked for one minute on a turned off stove, it will be cooked for ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a10fa55d1324328f9ba60c9343ed0ecb0506d678.png). Thus, after four minutes the chicken will be cooked for ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6fcc8bd6c2188b260d9d18e7b6c9e3908848df71.png). Before the fifth minute Julia will turn on the stove and after $2.5$ minutes the chicken will be ready ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/87a86c8e9632089279245fff912c077126c4e704.png).

In the second example, when the stove is turned off, Julia will immediately turn it on, so the stove will always be turned on and the chicken will be cooked in 20 minutes.
statementZhMd:
Julia 打算在宿舍的厨房里烹饪一只鸡。为了节省能源，厨房里的炉灶在打开 $*k*$ 分钟后会自动关闭。

烹饪过程中，Julia 每隔 $*d*$ 分钟去一次厨房，如果炉灶处于关闭状态，就将其打开。炉灶关闭时仍然保持温热。炉灶的开关会瞬间完成。

已知当炉灶打开时，鸡需要在炉灶上烹饪 $*t*$ 分钟；当炉灶关闭时，需要 $2*t*$ 分钟。假设鸡在炉灶打开和关闭时都以恒定速度均匀烹饪，请你求出 Julia 烹饪这只鸡需要多长时间。

## 输入格式

一行包含三个整数 $*k*$、$*d*$ 和 $*t*$（$1 ≤ *k*, *d*, *t* ≤ 10^{18}$）。

## 输出格式

输出烹饪所需的总时间，单位为分钟。答案的相对误差或绝对误差不超过 $10^{ - 9}$。

具体来说，假设你的答案为 $*x*$，评测程序的答案为 $*y*$。当且仅当 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2f8a2579030cb3dd486cf891669979cfd6c0cd65.png) 时，检查程序会判定你的答案正确。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，鸡先在打开的炉灶上烹饪 3 分钟，之后它还会烹饪 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cce5d3f2f46552034d5ae5d487725705429ec7a5.png)。然后，鸡在关闭的炉灶上烹饪 1 分钟，还需要烹饪 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a10fa55d1324328f9ba60c9343ed0ecb0506d678.png)。因此，4 分钟后鸡将烹饪完成 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6fcc8bd6c2188b260d9d18e7b6c9e3908848df71.png)。在第 5 分钟开始前，Julia 会打开炉灶，再经过 $2.5$ 分钟，鸡就准备好了 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/87a86c8e9632089279245fff912c077126c4e704.png)。

在第二个样例中，炉灶关闭后，Julia 会立即将其打开，因此炉灶始终处于打开状态，鸡将在 20 分钟内烹饪完成。
